items.headline: Which Airlines Are Still Skipping Dubai This Winter
items.body: Dubai’s airport is busy, but the long-haul airlines that fill its luxury hotels are mostly staying out until spring. Hotels organizing around a European winter rebound need to plan for a later one.

items.headline: Antarctic Tourism Is Booming. Guides Say Expertise Is Thinning
items.body: Antarctica’s ship capacity grew faster than its pool of experienced guides, and veterans say that’s changing what guests can safely do. The industry disputes that standards have slipped, but no single authority can cap growth on a continent governed by consensus.
